title: A clear, low-friction way to work together

steps.title: Clarify
steps.description: Confirm the goal, priority, deadline, tools, access, and what a successful handoff looks like.

steps.title: Organize
steps.description: Break the work into clear steps, gather references, and flag missing information early.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: Work through the agreed tasks carefully and keep progress visible.

steps.title: Review & hand over
steps.description: Check the work, document anything important, and confirm what is complete or needs a decision.
